svg:
Four things the dashboard keeps separate for each job Fit records the decision (apply now, investigate, monitor or skip) and how each requirement matches: strong, partial or gap. Listing status says whether the listing is open on the employer's site, listed on a board, closing soon, closed or needs a check, with a source link and check date. Employer identity is verified, likely or unclear. Application stage runs from discovered and shortlisted to applied, screen, interview and offer. A ready CV and letter pack does not change the stage. {% include diagrams/_style.html %}
Fit Apply now · Investigate Monitor · Skip Each requirement: strong, partial or gap
Listing Open · employer Listed · board · Closed Closing soon or Needs check, with source link and check date
Employer Verified · Likely Unclear Is this really the company behind the listing?
Application Discovered · Shortlisted Applied · Screen Interview · Offer Where the application stands A ready CV and letter pack doesn’t change the stage. A strong fit can still have a closed listing, and an open listing can still be a poor fit. Mixing them makes the totals meaningless.
